# Nexus v1.96.2 community update

This update contains the HUD fixes play tested on Project Ebonhold after the
v1.96.1 community release.

## Included

- Keeps the compact HUD visible at level 80 when no Echo board is active.
- Refreshes Still Needed and Missing Tomes after Echo or tome learning changes.
- Uses a 340-pixel HUD with readable columns and enough vertical room for TO LOCK.
- Fits the in-game update notice inside its frame.
- Keeps interim `1.96.x` peers from hiding the official Better-Nexus 1.20 notice.

## Install

Remove the old `Interface\AddOns\Nexus` folder, then extract the ZIP so the
final path is `Interface\AddOns\Nexus\Nexus.toc`. The runtime addon name and
SavedVariables remain unchanged.

## Verify the download

The release includes a `.sha256` file and a JSON build manifest containing the
exact tag commit and Git tree. GitHub Actions also records a signed build
provenance attestation for the ZIP.

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Nexus-v1.96.2.zip -Algorithm SHA256
gh attestation verify .\Nexus-v1.96.2.zip -R SchmidtCode/Good-Enough-Nexus
```

Compare the PowerShell hash with `Nexus-v1.96.2.zip.sha256`.
